description: This Java class 'HttpRequestPrettyPrintedDTO' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for serializing and deserializing HTTP request data in a pretty-printed format within the MockServer project. It extends 'RequestDefinition' and encapsulates HTTP request properties such as method, path, headers, cookies, query parameters, body, and connection flags.
